name: Monroe Plaza

Strategically located in Orange County's tourism corridor between Woodbury Common Premium Outlets and Legoland New York Resort, the center serves both a rapidly growing affluent residential base and over 5.9 million annual tourist visitors.

description: Monroe Plaza is a 122,007 square foot community shopping center strategically positioned along New York's Route 17M in Monroe, serving as a vital retail hub in Orange County's thriving tourism corridor. Anchored by the regionally dominant ShopRite grocery store, the center has established itself as a neighborhood destination for both local residents and the millions of tourists traveling between Woodbury Common Premium Outlets and Legoland New York Resort. The property features a diverse tenant mix including Scalia & Co Craft Kitchen+Bar, Best Of Little Italy restaurant, Happy Liquor, United States Postal Service, and various service-oriented businesses such as Advance Podiatry, Access PT, and Plaza Optical, creating a comprehensive shopping and dining experience. With excellent regional access provided by US Highway 6 within one mile, Monroe Plaza serves a rapidly growing trade area that is expanding at a rate 318% above the national average, supported by an affluent customer base with average household incomes exceeding $141,000 within a one-mile radius. The center's combination of essential grocery shopping, diverse dining options, and convenient services positions it as an integral part of the community's daily life while capitalizing on the substantial tourist traffic flowing through this dynamic Orange County corridor.
